_fixture_notes: Phase 1 test fixture. Fake user. Built the COMPLIANT way per D-010: every holding carries an
internal alias, never a real product or institution name. Characteristics follow D-013's field
lists per product type. This is what the backend would actually send to Sonnet.
Companion to FIXTURE_user_01 (BQ-002, traces to D-024/D-027 section 8: 'highest-value untested
thing remaining'). Deliberately has NO dominant number: user_01's Card-1 sits at 42% against a
next-highest of 9% (a ~4.6x jump), which may be why the model reliably picks it as the deepened
path (D-027 FINDING 4). Here the two debt instruments (Loan-1 home loan at 8.8%, Loan-2 personal loan at
13.5%) are close enough that picking the 'sharper' one is a genuine judgment call, not an
outlier any observer would spot instantly. Same 5-of-8 D-013 type coverage as user_01 (home_loan,
personal_loan instead of credit_card_debt, savings_balance, equity_mutual_fund, ppf_epf), same
known_gaps shape (no term insurance against the home loan + dependent). Amounts in INR.

holdings._note: Idle savings balance, not an FD. Same schema-exemption as user_01's Deposit-1.

known_gaps._note: Deliberate. User carries a 36L home loan and has one dependent, with no life cover recorded. Same D-012 AI-surfacing case as user_01, at smaller scale.
